title: Dubai logistics company: drivers' languages and pricing
scenario: Daniel talks to Omar, operations manager at a logistics company in Dubai, and his IT colleague Layla. They speak Modern Standard Arabic with Gulf expressions and English product names. A man and a woman on the far side, in Arabic, sometimes overlapping.

daniel.name: Daniel
daniel.accent_note: Gusan account manager, American English. Chris: casual American voice.

omar.name: Omar
omar.accent_note: Operations manager in Dubai: Modern Standard Arabic with Gulf expressions and English product names. Brian: deep American voice.

layla.name: Layla
layla.accent_note: IT lead in Dubai, Arabic. Lily: soft British voice.

turns.speaker: omar
turns.text: مرحباً دانيال، أهلاً وسهلاً. معي اليوم زميلتي ليلى من قسم تقنية المعلومات.

ref.en: Hello Daniel, welcome. With me today is my colleague Layla from the IT department.

turns.speaker: layla

ref.en: Hi Daniel, nice to meet you.

turns.notes: #short a woman right after a man on the same track: the hear voice must switch

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: I'm glad to meet you both. What do your teams use for calls today?

ref.ar: أنا سعيد بالتعرف عليكما. ماذا تستخدم فرقكم للمكالمات حالياً؟
ref.en: I'm glad to meet you both. What do your teams use for calls today?

turns.notes: #question #gender Arabic needs the masculine 'سعيد' (Daniel is a man) and the dual 'عليكما'

turns.speaker: omar
turns.text: في الغالب Microsoft Teams، وأحياناً Zoom مع العملاء. يعني، المشكلة أن نصف السائقين لا يتكلمون العربية.

ref.en: Mostly Microsoft Teams, and sometimes Zoom with clients. I mean, the problem is that half of the drivers don't speak Arabic.

turns.notes: #mixed #filler #glossary English product names inside Arabic; 'يعني' = I mean

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: That's exactly where Gusan helps. Which languages do they speak?

ref.ar: وهنا بالضبط يأتي دور Gusan. ما اللغات التي يتحدثونها؟
ref.en: That's exactly where Gusan helps. Which languages do they speak?

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: الأردية والهندية في الغالب، وبعضهم يتكلم الإنجليزية.

ref.en: Mostly Urdu and Hindi, and some of them speak English.

turns.speaker: omar
turns.text: وكم تكلفة الاشتراك إذا كان لدينا 150 مستخدماً؟

ref.en: And how much is the subscription if we have 150 users?

turns.notes: #overlap #question #numbers a man starts over a woman on the same (system) track

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: For 150 users, it's $3,600 a month, and the first month is free.

ref.ar: مع 150 مستخدماً، التكلفة 3600 دولار شهرياً، والشهر الأول مجاني.
ref.en: For 150 users, it's $3,600 a month, and the first month is free.
And is there a dashboard to track usage?

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: Yes, admins get a dashboard with the minutes per user.

ref.ar: نعم، لدى المسؤولين لوحة تحكم تعرض الدقائق لكل مستخدم.
ref.en: Yes, admins get a dashboard with the minutes per user.

turns.speaker: omar
turns.text: تمام. أرسل لنا العرض على الإيميل، وإن شاء الله نرد عليك يوم الاثنين.

ref.en: OK. Send us the offer by email, and hopefully we'll get back to you on Monday.
